title: Electric field magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly states the magnitude of the electric field as E = 2mv₀²/(qR).

title: Electric field direction
description: Essential: Correctly identifies the direction of the electric field as downward (negative y-axis).

title: Coordinates of point C
description: Essential: Correctly gives one or both sets of coordinates for point C: ((2±√3)R/2, -R/2).

title: Initial velocity for part (3)
description: Essential: Correctly gives one or both initial velocities: (2√2 ± √6)v₀/2.

title: Work-energy theorem application
description: Important: Applies the work-energy theorem (ΔK = qE·Δy) to relate kinetic energy gain to vertical displacement.

title: Kinematic decomposition
description: Important: Separates motion into horizontal (uniform) and vertical (uniformly accelerated) components.

title: Geometry of circular path
description: Important: Uses the circle equation (x-R)² + y² = R² to relate coordinates of exit points.

title: Time-of-flight consistency
description: Important: Recognizes that horizontal and vertical motions share the same time variable for a given trajectory.

title: Sign error in displacement
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign for vertical displacement (e.g., positive instead of negative for downward field).

title: Unit or dimension check
description: Optional: Performs a unit/dimensional analysis to verify expressions for E or velocity.
